scope: Unmodified production Runtime BGRA baseline; stage times use isolated instrumented build. No HTTP, PNG or video encoding inside frame timing. Process allocation is not native/GPU memory or retained heap. No performance optimization.

assessment.statistics: P95 uses linear interpolation at (n-1)*0.95. Independent batch medians are also reported; pooled frames are correlated.
assessment.scope: Uninstrumented baseline wall time is distinct from instrumented step time; original and traced same-backend frames must match. No CPU/GPU pixel equivalence claim.
